name: University of Mannheim
summary: Business, economics, law and social-science university in Mannheim; it currently offers only German-language bachelor's degrees.

ib.text: Every bachelor's needs German at C1 (TestDaF 4 in all parts, DSH 2, telc C1 Hochschule); IB German A at grade 6 or better exempts you. Your IB subjects must meet the KMK rule.

notes: The 2027 dates are not out yet; for 2026 bachelor's applications ran from 1 June to 15 July, or to 31 August for some Culture and Economy tracks.
Business Administration also asks for very good English (IELTS 7.0 or TOEFL iBT 100), and the certificate earns selection points only if it is in by 15 July.
